collapses below, four continents, one shared pattern

cases.name: Morandi Bridge
cases.signal: A satellite radar scatterer on the deck beside the failed pier accelerated from about 10 to 70 mm/yr starting March 2017, seventeen months before collapse (Milillo et al. 2019; contested by Lanari et al. 2020).
cases.missed: Displacement data, a cable strength-loss assessment and retrofit paperwork sat in separate silos. The retrofit was scheduled, not urgent.

cases.name: I-35W Mississippi River Bridge
cases.signal: Inspection photographs from 1999 and 2003 already showed visibly bowed gusset plates (NTSB HAR-08/03).
cases.missed: The record itself said deficient for years. Nothing forced escalation while construction load was added.

cases.name: FIU pedestrian bridge
cases.signal: Rapidly growing structural cracks, photographed and discussed by the engineer of record in the days before failure.
cases.missed: A meeting held the morning of the collapse concluded the cracks were not a safety concern.

cases.name: Champlain Towers South
cases.signal: A satellite study published in 2020 had identified the site subsiding by about 2 mm/yr in the 1990s (Fiaschi and Wdowinski); a 2018 engineering report documented major structural damage.
cases.missed: The subsidence study, the damage report and the deferred repair decisions were never combined.

cases.name: Morbi suspension footbridge
cases.signal: Reopened four days after a renovation that never replaced or load-tested the original main cables; the inquiry later found 22 of the 49 wires in the failed cable already corroded.
cases.missed: No independent check existed that the renovation record matched the physical state.

cases.name: Carola Bridge
cases.signal: Hidden hydrogen-induced corrosion of the prestressing steel, progressing for decades inside the one deck not yet refurbished (Marx report, TU Dresden).
cases.missed: The expert report concluded the required visual inspections could not have detected it. Partial coverage protects the spans you picked, not the one that fails.

cases.name: Metro Line 12 overpass
cases.signal: Structural concerns on the elevated section were documented repeatedly after the 2017 earthquake, years before the girder failed.
cases.missed: Reports and repairs stayed piecemeal; no mechanism tied the accumulating observations to a forced decision.

cases.name: Nanfang'ao Bridge
cases.signal: The official investigation found severe corrosion in the suspension rods that years of inspections had not addressed.
cases.missed: Inspection responsibility was fragmented across agencies; the corrosion sat in nobody's queue.
